(<hi type="bold">160</hi>)<div eID="gen88799" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88800" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">5 </hi>For the wickedness of Jacob is all this, And for the transgressions of the house of Israel: What is the wickedness of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Are they not <hi type="italic">those of</hi> Jerusalem? (<hi type="bold">162</hi>)<div eID="gen88800" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88801" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">6 </hi>I will therefore make Samaria A heap of the field, a plantation for vineyards; And I will roll into the valley its stones, And its foundations will I discover;<div eID="gen88801" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88802" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">7 </hi>And all her graven images shall be broken down, And all her rewards shall be burnt in the fire, And all her idols will I lay desolate; For from the reward of a harlot hath she gathered, And to the reward of a harlot shall they return.<div eID="gen88802" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88803" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">8 </hi>For this will I wail and howl, I will go spoiled and naked; I will make wailing as the dragons, And mourning as the daughters of the ostrich: (<hi type="bold">170</hi>)<div eID="gen88803" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88804" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">9 </hi>For grievous is her stroke, For it has come to Judah, It has reached the gate of my people—even Jerusalem.<div eID="gen88804" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88805" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">10 </hi>In Gath tell ye it not; weeping, weep not; In the house of Ophrah, roll thyself in the dust.<div eID="gen88805" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88806" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">11 </hi>Pass over also, thou inhabitant of Saphir, Naked and in shame; Go forth shall not the inhabitant of Zaanan, In the mourning of Beth-ezel; She will take from you her station. (<hi type="bold">176</hi>)<div eID="gen88806" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88807" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">12 </hi>Verily, grieved for good has the inhabitant of Maroth; For come down has evil from Jehovah To the gate of Jerusalem.<div eID="gen88807" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88808" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">13 </hi>Tie the chariot to the dromedary, Thou inhabitant of Lachish; The beginning of sin has she been to the daughter of Zion; For in thee have been found the transgressions of Israel.<div eID="gen88808" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88809" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">14 </hi>Thou shalt therefore send presents, For Moresheth-gath, to the sons of Achzib, (<hi type="bold">180</hi>) <hi type="italic">Who have been</hi> a deception to the kings of Israel.<div eID="gen88809" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88810" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">15 </hi>Yet a possessor will I send to thee, inhabitant of Mareshah; Even to Adullam, the glory of Israel, shall he come.<div eID="gen88810" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88811" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">16 </hi>Make bald, and poll thyself, For the children of thy delicacies; Enlarge thy baldness as the eagle, Inasmuch as they have migrated from thee.<div eID="gen88811" type="x-p"/><div eID="gen88794"/> <div sID="gen88812"/> <div sID="gen88813" type="x-p"/>CHAPTER 2<div eID="gen88813" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88814" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">1 </hi>Woe to those who devise iniquity, And contrive wickedness on their beds! When the morning shines, they execute it; For to do it their hand is ready.<div eID="gen88814" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88815" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">2 </hi>And they covet fields, and forcibly take them; And houses, and they take them away; And they oppress a man and his house, A man and his heritage. (<hi type="bold">187</hi>)<div eID="gen88815" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88816" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">3 </hi>Therefore, thus saith Jehovah, — Behold, I am devising against this family an evil, From which ye shall not remove your necks; And ye shall not walk in your height, For an evil time will it be.<div eID="gen88816" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88817" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">4 </hi>In that day shall they take up against thee a proverb, And bewail with a lamentable lament, And say, “Wasted, we are laid waste; The portion of my people has he changed; How he takes away from me instead of restoring! Our fields he divides.” (<hi type="bold">191</hi>)<div eID="gen88817" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88818" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">5 </hi>There shall not therefore be for thee One to cast a line for lot in the assembly of Jehovah.<div eID="gen88818" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen88819" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">6 </hi>“Prophecy not, ye who prophesy;” — They shall not prophesy for them; — He will not take reproaches.
